answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a unique physical sensor thread at a riverine wharf, hashing precipitation telemetry into a verifiable provenance chain. Tail-risk scoring then weights each agent by its fitted GEV shape parameter, so a Sybil cluster of cloned identities collapses to a single low-entropy pearl of shared provenance rather than many independent. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
